description: 25 hand-labelled question -> expected-section pairs over the corpus in evals/corpus/. Written before any run. Each case names fragments that must appear in the matched chunk's section trail; a case is a hit at k when any of the top-k chunks matches.
note: The `probe` field records what each case is meant to stress. `lexical` cases contain a rare literal token that dense embeddings tend to blur (LWP, PIP, garden leave). `semantic` cases deliberately share no content words with the target clause. `confusable` cases sit near a decoy section that uses similar vocabulary — three different policies define an 'eligibility' clause and two define an 'allowance'.
